title: Facebook Groups for Local Business: Building a Community

facts.fact: Buffer reports that over 1.8 billion people actively use Facebook Groups each month.
facts.quote: Over 1.8 billion people actively use Facebook Groups each month

facts.fact: The article was published on April 15, 2026.
Adwave's article states that 89% of potential local customers may never see Facebook Group content, a figure given without a cited source.
facts.quote: as 89% of potential local customers may never see group content.

facts.fact: The article recommends that a healthy local Facebook Group run on four content pillars: expert guidance, member spotlight content, behind-the-scenes posts, and light participation prompts.

facts.fact: The article's suggested enforcement ladder for group rule violations is to remove the post and send a polite note on the first issue, apply a temporary post approval requirement or warning on the second, and remove the member on the third.
facts.quote: Remove the post and send a polite note.

facts.fact: A 2025 survey found that 73% of small businesses using Facebook Groups for local marketing could not accurately attribute revenue to group activities.
